title: Why Japanese Bicycles Often Ride on Sidewalks
seo_title: Why Japanese Bicycles Often Ride on Sidewalks
description: Bicycles in Japan belong on the road by default, yet many ride on sidewalks. Learn the Road Traffic Act exceptions, mixed street design, and how to share space without treating the sidewalk as a bike lane.
